source_rehash.reason: prepare_footprint now states the shape fidelity it requires and lets the simplification tolerance find itself, instead of fixing the tolerance and accepting whatever signed area change it produced
source_rehash.why_it_was_needed: the old gate measured signed area, which cancels: a polygon could be badly distorted and still pass, and a finer tolerance could score worse on area while being geometrically closer. Measured over the whole Valencia stock (26 417 footprints): 23 buildings were rejected outright by that gate and 44 were accepted while exceeding the 1 % bound, worst 2.5977 %. Error is now symmetric difference over raw area, which is >= |area difference| always, so nothing that passes the new gate could have failed the old one. The bound is the existing max_area_delta_fraction - no new constant. Rejections for simplification are now structurally impossible for any city, not just Valencia: the ladder refines to 1 cm and falls back to the raw polygon
source_rehash.physics_unchanged: --verify re-run against the Rai reference after the change: 13/13 gates PASS and every gate is bit-for-bit identical to the values recorded before it (954.800 m2 residential area, 465.000 m2 gross wall, U 1.409/2.496/0.501, people 73.530 GJ, lighting 65.308, equipment 56.543, DHW 36.057, pumps 1.169, HVAC sensible heating 26.527, cooling -68.403, total site 53.680 kWh/m2). Structurally neither change can reach the replica: build_rai_reference_replica() builds its rectangle from rect.exterior.coords and never calls prepare_footprint, and residential_storeys_from_cadastre is not referenced in verified_model.py. The frozen pilot regression also reproduces 11.21 / 16.60 kWh/m2 with QA ALL CHECKS PASSED, S1 6.46 / S2 3.68 kgCO2/m2, and unchanged geometry (11 neighbours, 20.04 m party wall, 6 party surfaces, 100 windows, 30 balcony doors, 219.6 m2 glazing, 69 shading surfaces).
source_rehash.measured_effect: 26 338 of 26 417 footprints (99.701 %) come out byte-identical. 44 were refined finer and 35 took a strictly-dominant coarser candidate - lower error AND no more vertices, so no trade-off was made. Buildings worse in shape than the current tol 0.1: 0. Worse than the tol 0.3 used for the published run: 0. Fidelity over the 1 % bound: 0, against 44 today
source_rehash.workbench_unaffected: prepare_footprint keeps its (coords, area) contract as a thin wrapper over the new prepare_footprint_detail(), so all six call sites - including workbench/service.py - are unchanged. No adapter, scenario or LHS code path moved
source_rehash.no_result_invalidated: no committed run is rewritten. Past runs stay on the profile they were produced under; the new gate only changes which buildings a FUTURE run admits and how faithfully their footprints are simplified
source_rehash.accompanying_changes: this fixture pins model_builder.py only, and the reason above is why THAT file moved. The same commit also changes deep_building.py (not pinned by any fixture) in two ways, so the profile fingerprint moves for three reasons together: (a) the storey rule now resolves cadastral/footprint no finer than the inputs allow, snapping to a whole storey inside the same max_area_delta_fraction band - it can only ever REMOVE a near-empty storey, never add one; (b) the window frame step no longer rejects a building that had nothing to frame, only one where glazing existed and none of it took the frame. (b) fixes 112 of the 113 failures in ALL-VALENC-A_unfinished - inner-block parcels walled in on all four sides

source_rehash_history.reason: run_energyplus gained an optional epw_path argument so a scenario weather file reaches EnergyPlus itself
source_rehash_history.why_it_was_needed: EnergyPlus's --weather overrides the model, so mb.set_weather_file() alone changed nothing: measured 2026-07-30, an EPW with every hour +5 K and the city renamed gave a byte-identical result while eplusout.eio named VALENCIA and the OSM named TESTCITY
source_rehash_history.physics_unchanged: epw_path defaults to None -> mb.EPW_FILE, i.e. the previous behaviour; pilot regression 11.21 / 16.60 kWh/m2 QA ALL PASSED, verified_model --verify 13/13 with every gate bit-identical to the previous golden
source_rehash_history.workbench_unaffected: simulation_adapter.py sets runner.mb.EPW_FILE around the call; with epw_path unset the fallback is still mb.EPW_FILE, so Part B/G behave exactly as before
source_rehash_history.no_result_invalidated: the project has only ever held one EPW (ESP_Valencia.082840_IWEC.epw), so no recorded run was ever produced through the broken --epw path

source_rehash_history.reason: model_builder.FOOTPRINT_RANGE is now derived from DEFAULT_BUILD_CONFIG.geometry instead of restating a literal (50.0, 5000.0)
source_rehash_history.why_it_was_needed: the footprint ceiling was raised from 5 000 to 20 000 m2 on 2026-08-03. At 5 000 the gate excluded 123 Valencia buildings carrying 11.55 % of the city's floor area, so a city total silently stood for 87.5 % of the stock; the new ceiling brings area coverage to 98.38 %. The constant was dead code - the real gate in prepare_footprint() reads the config - so leaving it would have parked a wrong (50, 5000) two lines above the working gate
source_rehash_history.physics_unchanged: verified_model --verify 13/13 PASS with every gate bit-identical to the previous golden: residential area 954.800, wall U 1.409, people 73.530, heating 26.527, cooling -68.403, total site 53.680 kWh/m2. Rai's replica is 954.8 m2, far from either ceiling, so no gate could move
source_rehash_history.workbench_unaffected: the ceiling is a BuildConfig field the UI already exposes and validates (ConfigPanel footprint_max_m2); no adapter, scenario or LHS code path changed, and the frontend suite passes 51/51
source_rehash_history.no_result_invalidated: no committed run is rewritten. Past runs stay on the profile they were produced under; the new ceiling only changes which buildings a FUTURE run admits

source_rehash_history.reason: run_simulation.EPLUS_DIR is now resolved per platform (env override -> install matching the OpenStudio SDK in use -> newest install -> the macOS path developed against) instead of a hardcoded /Applications literal.
source_rehash_history.why_it_was_needed: The literal meant the chain could only ever run on the machine it was written on. Rai and Javier install the Workbench on their own computers, on Windows and macOS.
source_rehash_history.physics_unchanged_evidence: resolve_eplus_dir() returns the identical string on this machine; verified_model --verify 13/13 byte-identical (total_site 53.680 kWh/m2, wall U 1.409, DHW 36.057 GJ); frozen pilot run_simulation.py 11.21/16.60 QA ALL PASSED with 11 warnings.
